UI_CSV_Option_3: Volume of your character and local previews. Range: 0-200 percent. Default: 100 percent. Zero mutes. Recording peak limits can cap amplification.
UI_CSV_Option_5: Volume of other players using this voice pack. Range: 0-200 percent. Default: 100 percent. Does not change their zombie hearing distance.
UI_CSV_Option_7: Off disables loot speech. Needs only keeps current needs and excludes weapon discoveries and generic container comments. Useful finds enables all verified discoveries. Default: Useful finds. Raw auditions stay available.
UI_CSV_Option_12: Sparse: 90 sec between finds, 10 min per category. Normal: 30 sec / 3 min. Frequent: 10 sec / 1 min. Danger speech is unchanged.
UI_CSV_Option_17: Show speech auditions, scenarios and report export in the right-click menu. Default: on. Previews are local and do not attract zombies.
UI_CSV_Option_19: Ordinary comments: sparse, normal, frequent. Default: Normal. Loot uses its separate frequency option. Urgent danger keeps its own cooldown.
UI_CSV_Option_21: While sneaking, use a matching recorded whisper when available; otherwise remain silent. Default: off. Fire and fresh injury can still cause a cry.
UI_CSV_Option_23: Hear eligible thoughts locally. Default: off. Other players and zombies cannot hear them. Recordings may still sound spoken.
UI_CSV_Option_25: Allow ordinary comments when surroundings are verified safe. Default: on. Unknown surroundings keep the original speech filters.
UI_CSV_MarkShelter: Remember this place as my shelter
UI_CSV_ProfanityHelp: Play recordings with swearing. Off selects a clean alternative or stays silent. Applies to your voice, other players and previews.
UI_CSV_PitchOffsetHelp: Absolute pitch of the current saved character. Loaded automatically. Apply saves to this character only. No character: disabled.
